Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Fabric Haven Supply Co. is a retail business specializing in the sale of fabrics, sewing supplies, and related materials. Our operations include a well-curated selection of high-quality fabrics, threads, notions, and sewing patterns both in-store and through our e-commerce platform. We do not engage in sewing machine repairs or maintenance services. Our store prioritizes safe handling practices for all materials and regular employee training on compliance with safety protocols. We limit customer classes to small groups led by certified instructors. We have implemented robust fire prevention measures, including storing any required chemicals in approved safety cabinets in compliance with local fire codes. Additionally, we maintain a secure surveillance system to deter theft and protect our inventory.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a small fire occurred in the storage area due to an electrical fault, which caused damage to some fabric inventory. The estimated loss amount was $1,000. The fire was extinguished with no injuries reported, and all safety protocols were followed. The incident has been resolved and is currently closed.
